title: PACE%2BCode%2BB%2B2023.pdf — section 26
text:
6.7 If an officer conducts a search to which this Code applies the officer shall, unless it is
impracticable to do so, provide the occupier with a copy of a Notice in a standard format:
(i) specifying if the search is made under warrant, with consent, or in the exercise of the
powers described in paragraphs 4.1 to 4.3. Note: the notice format shall provide for
authority or consent to be indicated (see paragraphs 4.3 and 5.1);
(ii) summarising the extent of the powers of search and seizure conferred by PACE and
other relevant legislation as appropriate;
(iii) explaining the rights of the occupier and the owner of the property seized;
(iv) explaining compensation may be payable in appropriate cases for damages caused
entering and searching premises, and giving the address to send a compensation
application (see Note 6A), and
(v) stating this Code is available at any police station.
